title: Crib-wall sitework across two lots: B1.3.6 applied lot by lot (Thames)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code B1.3.6 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Applicants own a neighbouring property; sitework was carried out on two lots (101B and 101C) by one developer who owned both lots; Thames-Coromandel District Council is the authority.
Developer's geotechnical assessments (April 2016) gave foundation options based on a crib wall retaining the upper slopes; no slope-stability analysis of the embankment was carried out.
Matter: whether the building work on each lot complies with B1.3.6; the authority's decision not to issue a notice to fix for the sitework is also examined.

Decision: building work on 101B does not comply with B1.3.6; building work on 101C complies; authority incorrect to refuse a notice to fix for the sitework, but no value in directing a reversal (7 July 2022).

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
The determination's decision section is in the same PDF; outcome leakage is true. Use only pages 1-34 as applicant-side input if pages are split.
Facts are taken from the text layer (pypdf); photos, drawings and figures were not visually inspected unless stated.
